name: The Tongue
overview: Scripture reveals the tremendous power of the tongue, urging believers to guard their speech carefully. The Psalms emphasize the need to keep the tongue from evil and to ask the Lord to watch over our lips, highlighting the spiritual discipline involved in controlling our words. Proverbs teaches that restraint in speech is wise and life-preserving, while careless or harsh words can cause harm and destruction. A gentle answer can defuse anger, demonstrating that the tongue can either bring healing or harm depending on how it is used.
